title: Why Football Legends Still Can't Explain Haaland

lines.text: Pep Guardiola called him a scoring machine.
lines.spoken: Pep Guardiola called him a scoring machine.
lines.tr: Pep Guardiola ona gol makinesi dedi.
lines.tr_spoken: Guardiola: makine.

lines.text: Jürgen Klopp called him a real beast.
lines.spoken: Yurgen Klopp called him a real beast.
lines.tr: Jürgen Klopp ona gerçek bir canavar dedi.
lines.tr_spoken: Klopp: canavar.

lines.text: Roy Keane said he looked almost like a League Two player.
lines.spoken: Roy Keane said he looked almost like a League Two player.
lines.tr: Roy Keane ise neredeyse dördüncü lig oyuncusu gibi göründüğünü söyledi.
lines.tr_spoken: Keane: dördüncü lig oyuncusu.

lines.text: So which one is it? To find out, start with one night in July.
lines.spoken: So which one is it? To find out, you have to start with one night in July.
lines.tr: Peki hangisi doğru? Bunu anlamak için temmuzdaki bir geceden başlamak gerek.
lines.tr_spoken: Hangisi doğru? Temmuzdaki bir geceden başlayalım.

lines.text: July 5th, 2026. A World Cup knockout game. Norway against Brazil.
lines.spoken: July the fifth, twenty twenty-six. A World Cup knockout game. Norway, against Brazil.
lines.tr: 5 Temmuz 2026. Dünya Kupası'nda eleme maçı. Norveç, Brezilya'ya karşı.
lines.hero: date set big over the stadium
lines.tr_spoken: Beş Temmuz, iki bin yirmi altı. Dünya Kupası, eleme maçı. Norveç, Brezilya'ya karşı.

lines.text: 79 minutes gone. He scores. 90 on the clock, and he scores again.
lines.spoken: Seventy-nine minutes gone. He scores. Ninety on the clock... and he scores again.
lines.tr: 79. dakika. Golü atıyor. 90. dakika... ve bir gol daha.
lines.tr_spoken: Yetmiş dokuzuncu dakika, gol. Doksanıncı dakika, bir gol daha.

lines.text: Brazil are out. Norway are in their first ever World Cup quarter-final.
lines.spoken: Brazil are out. And Norway are in their first ever World Cup quarter-final.
lines.tr: Brezilya elendi. Norveç tarihinde ilk kez Dünya Kupası çeyrek finalinde.

lines.text: His name is Erling Haaland. And even football's greatest legends still can't explain him.
lines.spoken: His name is Erling Haaland. And even football's greatest legends still can't explain him.
lines.tr: Adı Erling Haaland. Ve futbolun en büyük efsaneleri bile onu hâlâ açıklayamıyor.
lines.typed: WHY FOOTBALL LEGENDS STILL CAN'T EXPLAIN HAALAND

lines.text: But the story doesn't start in Norway. It starts in Leeds, England. July 21st, 2000.
lines.spoken: But the story doesn't start in Norway. It starts in Leeds, England. July the twenty-first, two thousand.
lines.tr: Ama hikâye Norveç'te başlamıyor. İngiltere'de, Leeds'te başlıyor. 21 Temmuz 2000.
lines.tr_spoken: Ama hikâye Norveç'te başlamıyor. İngiltere'de, Leeds'te başlıyor. Yirmi bir Temmuz, iki bin.

lines.text: His dad, Alf-Inge Haaland, played in the Premier League, for Leeds and for Manchester City. Remember that.
lines.spoken: His dad, Alf-Inge Haaland, played in the Premier League, for Leeds, and for Manchester City. Remember that.
lines.tr: Babası Alf-Inge Haaland Premier Lig'de oynadı: Leeds'te ve Manchester City'de. Bunu aklınızda tutun.
lines.tr_spoken: Babası Alf-İnge Haaland, Premier Lig'de Leeds ve Manchester City'de oynadı. Bunu unutmayın.

lines.text: Soon after, the family moved back to Bryne, a small town on Norway's west coast. That's where he learned the game.
lines.spoken: Soon after, the family moved back to Bryne, a small town on Norway's west coast. That's where he learned the game.
lines.tr: Kısa süre sonra aile Norveç'in batı kıyısındaki küçük Bryne kasabasına döndü. Futbolu orada öğrendi.

lines.text: Fast forward to May 2019. The Under-20 World Cup in Poland. Norway against Honduras.
lines.spoken: Fast forward to May, twenty nineteen. The Under-Twenty World Cup, in Poland. Norway, against Honduras.
lines.tr: Mayıs 2019'a gelelim. Polonya'da 20 Yaş Altı Dünya Kupası. Norveç, Honduras'a karşı.
lines.tr_spoken: Mayıs, iki bin on dokuz. Polonya'da, yirmi yaş altı Dünya Kupası. Norveç, Honduras'a karşı.

lines.text: He scores nine. In one game. Before that night, nobody at the tournament had scored more than six in a match.
lines.spoken: He scores nine. In one game. Before that night, nobody at the tournament had ever scored more than six in a match.
lines.tr: Dokuz gol atıyor. Tek maçta. O geceye kadar turnuvada kimse bir maçta altıdan fazla atamamıştı.

lines.text: Four months later: his first Champions League game, for Red Bull Salzburg. Hat-trick.
lines.spoken: Four months later, his first ever Champions League game, for Red Bull Salzburg. Hat-trick.
lines.tr: Dört ay sonra Red Bull Salzburg formasıyla ilk Şampiyonlar Ligi maçı. Hat-trick.

lines.text: January 2020. Borussia Dortmund came calling.
lines.spoken: January, twenty twenty. Borussia Dortmund came calling.
lines.tr: Ocak 2020. Borussia Dortmund kapıyı çaldı.
lines.tr_spoken: Ocak, iki bin yirmi. Borussia Dortmund kapıyı çaldı.

lines.text: His debut? He came off the bench and scored a hat-trick in about twenty minutes.
lines.spoken: His debut? He came off the bench, and scored a hat-trick in about twenty minutes.
lines.tr: İlk maçı mı? Yedek kulübesinden girdi ve yaklaşık yirmi dakikada hat-trick yaptı.

lines.text: By the time he left: 86 goals in 89 games.
lines.spoken: By the time he left: eighty-six goals, in eighty-nine games.
lines.tr: Ayrıldığında: 89 maçta 86 gol.
lines.tr_spoken: Ayrıldığında: seksen dokuz maçta, seksen altı gol.

lines.text: Every big club in Europe wanted him. In 2022, he chose his father's old club.
lines.spoken: Every big club in Europe wanted him. And in twenty twenty-two, he chose his father's old club.
lines.tr: Avrupa'nın bütün büyükleri onu istiyordu. 2022'de babasının eski kulübünü seçti.
lines.hero: string from father card to City card
lines.tr_spoken: Avrupa'nın bütün büyükleri onu istiyordu. İki bin yirmi ikide, babasının eski kulübünü seçti.

lines.text: Even rivals were worried. Jürgen Klopp called him a real beast. And, unfortunately for Liverpool, a really good signing.
lines.spoken: Even rivals were worried. Yurgen Klopp called him a real beast. And, unfortunately for Liverpool, a really good signing.
lines.tr: Rakipler bile endişeliydi. Klopp ona gerçek bir canavar dedi. Liverpool için ne yazık ki çok iyi bir transfer.

lines.text: He was right. In his first season, Haaland scored 36 Premier League goals. A new record.
lines.spoken: He was right. In his first season, Haaland scored thirty-six Premier League goals. A new record.
lines.tr: Haklıydı. Haaland ilk sezonunda Premier Lig'de 36 gol attı. Yeni rekor.
lines.tr_spoken: Haklıydı. Haaland ilk sezonunda Premier Lig'de otuz altı gol attı. Yeni rekor.

lines.text: The old record? 34, held by Alan Shearer and Andy Cole. In seasons with 42 games.
lines.spoken: The old record? Thirty-four, held by Alan Shearer and Andy Cole. In seasons with forty-two games.
lines.tr: Eski rekor mu? 34. Alan Shearer ve Andy Cole'a aitti. Hem de 42 maçlık sezonlarda.
lines.tr_spoken: Eski rekor mu? Otuz dört. Alan Shearer ve Andy Cole'undu. Hem de kırk iki maçlık sezonlarda.

lines.text: Pep Guardiola gave him a nickname: the scoring machine.
lines.spoken: Pep Guardiola gave him a nickname: the scoring machine.
lines.tr: Guardiola ona bir lakap taktı: gol makinesi.

lines.text: And that same season, Manchester City won the Treble.
lines.spoken: And that same season, Manchester City won the Treble.
lines.tr: Ve aynı sezon Manchester City üçlemeyi kazandı.
lines.typed: PREMIER LEAGUE · FA CUP · CHAMPIONS LEAGUE

lines.text: But here's the thing. Not everyone was convinced.
lines.spoken: But here's the thing. Not everyone was convinced.
lines.tr: Ama işin bir de öbür yüzü var. Herkes ikna olmamıştı.

lines.text: In 2024, Roy Keane said that in general play, Haaland looked almost like a League Two player.
lines.spoken: In twenty twenty-four, Roy Keane said that in general play, Haaland looked almost like a League Two player.
lines.tr: 2024'te Roy Keane, oyunun genelinde Haaland'ın neredeyse dördüncü lig oyuncusu gibi göründüğünü söyledi.
lines.typed: "ALMOST LIKE A LEAGUE TWO PLAYER" · ROY KEANE
lines.tr_spoken: İki bin yirmi dörtte Roy Keane, Haaland'ın neredeyse dördüncü lig oyuncusu gibi göründüğünü söyledi.

lines.text: Haaland's reply was short: "I really don't care about that man."
lines.spoken: Haaland's reply was short. I really don't care about that man.
lines.tr: Haaland'ın cevabı kısaydı: O adam umurumda değil.

lines.text: Then he answered on the pitch. Premier League goal number 100. In just 111 games.
lines.spoken: Then he answered on the pitch. Premier League goal number one hundred. In just one hundred and eleven games.
lines.tr: Sonra cevabı sahada verdi. Premier Lig'de 100. gol. Sadece 111 maçta.
lines.tr_spoken: Sonra cevabı sahada verdi. Premier Lig'de yüzüncü gol. Sadece yüz on bir maçta.

lines.text: Alan Shearer, the league's all-time top scorer, needed 124.
lines.spoken: Alan Shearer, the league's all-time top scorer, needed one hundred and twenty-four.
lines.tr: Ligin tüm zamanların golcüsü Alan Shearer'ın buna 124 maçı gerekmişti.
lines.tr_spoken: Ligin rekortmeni Alan Shearer'a, yüz yirmi dört maç gerekmişti.

lines.text: Shearer said it himself: if Haaland stays long enough, there's no doubt he will break that record too.
lines.spoken: Shearer said it himself. If Haaland stays long enough, there's no doubt he will break that record too.
lines.tr: Shearer bunu kendisi söyledi: Haaland yeterince kalırsa o rekoru da kıracağına şüphe yok.
lines.typed: "NO DOUBT HE WILL BREAK THAT RECORD" · ALAN SHEARER
lines.tr_spoken: Shearer da söyledi: Haaland yeterince kalırsa, o rekoru da kırar.

lines.text: And for Norway, he became the country's all-time top scorer.
lines.spoken: And for Norway, he became the country's all-time top scorer.
lines.tr: Norveç'te ise ülkenin tüm zamanların en golcüsü oldu.

lines.text: But Norway hadn't played at a World Cup since 1998. First, they had to qualify. They won all eight games.
lines.spoken: But Norway hadn't played at a World Cup since nineteen ninety-eight. So first, they had to qualify. They won all eight games.
lines.tr: Ama Norveç 1998'den beri Dünya Kupası'na gidemiyordu. Önce eleme vardı. Sekiz maçın hepsini kazandılar.
lines.tr_spoken: Ama Norveç, doksan sekizden beri Dünya Kupası'na gidemiyordu. Önce eleme vardı. Sekiz maçta, sekiz galibiyet.

lines.text: Haaland scored in every single one. 16 goals.
lines.spoken: Haaland scored in every single one. Sixteen goals.
lines.tr: Haaland hepsinde gol attı. 16 gol.
lines.tr_spoken: Haaland hepsinde gol attı. On altı gol.

lines.text: The last one: a 4-1 win over Italy, in Milan. Norway's first World Cup in 28 years.
lines.spoken: The last one, a four-one win over Italy, in Milan. Norway's first World Cup in twenty-eight years.
lines.tr: Sonuncusu Milano'da İtalya'ya karşı 4-1. Norveç 28 yıl sonra Dünya Kupası'nda.
lines.tr_spoken: Sonuncusu Milano'da, İtalya'ya karşı dört bir. Norveç, yirmi sekiz yıl sonra Dünya Kupası'nda.

lines.text: And at the World Cup itself? He did what he always does.
lines.spoken: And at the World Cup itself? He did what he always does.
lines.tr: Peki Dünya Kupası'nda? Her zaman yaptığını yaptı.

lines.text: Two against Iraq. Two against Senegal. The winner against Ivory Coast. Two to knock out Brazil.
lines.spoken: Two against Iraq. Two against Senegal. The winner against Ivory Coast. Two, to knock out Brazil.
lines.tr: Irak'a iki. Senegal'e iki. Fildişi Sahili'ne galibiyet golü. Brezilya'yı eleyen iki gol.

lines.text: England ended the run in the quarter-final. But he went home with seven goals.
lines.spoken: England ended the run in the quarter-final. But he went home with seven goals.
lines.tr: Yolculuğu çeyrek finalde İngiltere bitirdi. Ama yedi golle döndü.

lines.text: And this season? Top of the Premier League scoring charts again. 9 goals in 11 games.
lines.spoken: And this season? Top of the Premier League scoring charts again. Nine goals in eleven games.
lines.tr: Ya bu sezon? Yine Premier Lig'in gol kralı: 11 maçta 9 gol.
lines.tr_spoken: Ya bu sezon? Yine Premier Lig'in gol kralı. On bir maçta dokuz gol.

lines.text: Nine goals in one game at eighteen. A World Cup quarter-final at twenty-five. And he's still only twenty-six.
lines.spoken: Nine goals in one game at eighteen. A World Cup quarter-final at twenty-five. And he's still only twenty-six.
lines.tr: On sekizinde tek maçta dokuz gol. Yirmi beşinde Dünya Kupası çeyrek finali. Ve daha yirmi altı yaşında.
lines.hero: pull back over the whole board

lines.text: Machine, beast, or League Two player? Maybe that's why the legends can't explain him. He isn't finished yet.
lines.spoken: So. Machine, beast, or League Two player? Maybe that's why the legends can't explain him. He isn't finished yet.
lines.tr: Makine mi, canavar mı, dördüncü lig oyuncusu mu? Belki de efsanelerin onu açıklayamamasının sebebi bu. Daha bitmedi.

lines.text: Who will he become? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe, because next, it's Mbappé.
lines.spoken: Who will he become? Tell us in the comments. And subscribe, because next, it's Mbappé.
lines.tr: Sence nasıl bir oyuncuya dönüşecek? Yorumlara yaz ve abone ol, sırada Mbappé var.

fact_notes: WC 2026 (ESPN fifa.world scoreboard): Norway-Iraq 16.06 Haaland 29',43'; Senegal-Norway 23.06 Haaland 48',58'; Ivory Coast-Norway 30.06 Haaland 86' winner; Brazil-Norway 05.07 Haaland 79',90', Neymar 90+10' (1-2); England-Norway QF 11.07 Bellingham 45+2',93'. 7 goals also Paddy Power 23.11.2026 + Klinpredict. First ever Norway WC quarter-final (Klinpredict + Norway history).
Born 21 July 2000, Leeds; father Alf-Inge Haaland (Leeds, Man City); raised in Bryne.
U20 WC 30 May 2019 Norway 12-0 Honduras, 9 goals; previous match record 6 (ESPN, CBS, FIFA, SI).
UCL debut hat-trick for Salzburg vs Genk, 17 Sep 2019 (widely reported).
Klopp May 2022: 'a real beast', 'unfortunately, a really good signing' (Goal.com, JOE).
36 PL goals 2022-23 record, previous 34 Shearer & Cole in 42-game seasons (AP/WTOP, SI).
Guardiola May 2023: 'the scoring machine Erling' (AP/WTOP, Gulf News).
100th PL goal in 111th appearance; Shearer 124 (ESPN AU, ExtraTimeTalk).
Shearer: 'If he stays for that long, no doubt he will break that record' (Goal.com, Sportskeeda).
Norway all-time top scorer (NBC Sports 21.11.2026, Paddy Power).
Dortmund debut Jan 2020 vs Augsburg: off the bench, hat-trick in ~20 min (widely reported).

Keane 'almost like a League Two player' in general play — Sky Sports, after City 0-0 Arsenal, end of March 2024 (Sportbible, Yahoo/Goal); Haaland: 'I really don't care about that man' (Yahoo, Sportbible).
WC qualifying 2025: 8 wins from 8, Haaland scored in all 8, 16 goals; 4-1 at Italy in Milan 16.11.2025; first WC since 1998 (ESPN, TSN, The Star, Arab News).
Norway previous WC 1998 (ESPN/TSN). Haaland age 18 at U20 WC May 2019, 25 at WC QF July 2026 (born 21.07.2000).
